scope: Import of a Supabase-shaped project into a new environment on a clean GitHub runner, not a real server: the source is another environment read through its developer login and gateway, as a Supabase project is through its postgres user and API; the imported user signs in with the old password, row level security, a private file with its Storage policy and a sign-up trigger on auth.users carry over, and a second import into the full environment is refused. Not a Supabase Cloud project. Transcribed from the CI docker-install job 107535197021 (run 35969253029, commit 3a662ad); environment identifiers shortened to e_….

checks.check: the source has a user with a protected row and a private file
a new environment is provisioned for the import
the import runs to the end and verifies its counts
checks.detail: manual steps listed (SMTP and email templates, site URL and redirects, Edge Functions listed only, new publishable keys); imported

checks.check: the imported user signs in with the old password
row level security came along: the user reads their own row
the user downloads their own file, byte for byte
a new sign-up runs the imported trigger on auth.users
a second import into the now full environment is refused
checks.detail: refused: the target environment is not empty; create a new environment to import into
